_comment: Tier-2 for febio::polar_fluid#3. Two invented names, caught at DIFFERENT stages: <bc type="zero micro-rotation"> is a parse error ('tag "bc" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"'), while <var type="micro rotation"/> reads SUCCESS and only then aborts with 'FATAL ERROR: Output variable "micro rotation" is not defined'. The fixture asserts read_success on the second, which is the stage difference the claim is about. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'polar_names=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
